issues.title: DKIM key is too weak
issues.detail: Selector default key size is 512 bits.
issues.recommendation: Rotate selector to at least 2048-bit RSA key material.

issues.title: DMARC record missing
issues.detail: No DMARC TXT record was found.
issues.recommendation: Publish a DMARC record with at least p=none and reporting, then move to p=quarantine/reject.

issues.title: SPF allows all senders
issues.detail: SPF ends in '+all' which permits spoofing.
issues.recommendation: Replace '+all' with '-all' after validating legitimate senders.
